disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码、构建产物与文档中与密钥凭据相关的内容（API Key、令牌、私钥、助记词等硬编码模式），未检出任何硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, build artifacts, and documentation for content related to credentials and secrets (hardcoded patterns such as API keys, tokens, private keys, mnemonic phrases, etc.); no hardcoded credentials were detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件代码是否读取用户凭据或敏感文件（如凭据目录、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭据），插件本体没有读取文件的能力，未检出相关调用。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin code reads user credentials or sensitive files (e.g., credential directories, SSH private keys, cloud provider credentials). The plugin itself has no file-reading capability, and no related calls were detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否有云环境、Kubernetes 等基础设施凭据枚举行为，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for any enumeration of infrastructure credentials in cloud environments, Kubernetes, etc. — not detected.

evidence.zh: 插件没有读取任何凭据或敏感路径的代码；整个包只有 DOM 属性打标与插件行聚合，无文件系统访问面，凭据外泄无通道。
evidence.en: The plugin contains no code that reads any credentials or sensitive paths; the entire package only performs DOM attribute tagging and plugin-line aggregation, with no file system access surface. There is no channel for credential exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 审查了全部可能进入大模型上下文的文本面：插件未注册任何工具，也没有向系统提示注入任何片段，不存在工具描述投毒或系统提示注入面。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all text surfaces that could enter the large model context: the plugin registers no tools and injects no fragments into the system prompt. There is no tool-description poisoning or system prompt injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 通读了仓库内面向开发者的说明文档与智能体说明文件，未发现伪装高权限消息、指令覆写、诱导安装或诱导放开权限等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the developer-facing documentation and agent instruction files in the repository. No injection wording was found, such as disguised high-privilege messages, instruction overrides, induced installation, or induced permission granting.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否有通过外部链接拉取指令、把远端内容当作规则等做法，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for practices like pulling instructions from external links or treating remote content as rules — none detected.

evidence.zh: 插件没有注册任何工具（宿主半区为空实现），也没有调用系统提示片段注入接口，工具描述投毒无落点。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools (the host half is an empty implementation) and calls no system prompt fragment injection interface. Tool-description poisoning has no landing point.

evidence.zh: 全部文档与说明中的安装指引均为正常的用户操作说明，未发现诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: All installation instructions in the documentation and descriptions are normal user operation guides. No wording was found that induces the model to execute installation, modify configuration, or grant permissions.

checked_items.zh: 对全部源码、构建产物与补丁文件做了执行类危险模式扫描（动态求值、远程下载即执行、子进程调用等），未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, build artifacts, and patch files for dangerous execution patterns (dynamic evaluation, download-and-execute from remote sources, subprocess invocation, etc.) — none detected.

checked_items.zh: 逐行核读了补丁文件：全部为插件行插入，不含任何可执行脚本标记，不存在补丁触发代码执行的路径。
checked_items.en: Line-by-line review of the patch file: it only inserts plugin lines, contains no executable script markers, and there is no path for the patch to trigger code execution.

checked_items.zh: 核读了两条机械预扫命中：构建产物地图文件（超长行信号）实为标准构建产物，内容与源码一致，非混淆代码；安装钩子内容仅为构建工具调用，属常规构建脚本。两条均排除，不构成发现项（裁决详情见审计范围限制）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the two mechanical pre-scan hits: the build artifact map file (overlong line signal) is confirmed as a standard build artifact, with content consistent with the source code, not obfuscated code; the install hook content is only a build tool invocation, a conventional build script. Both are dismissed and do not constitute findings (adjudication details in the audit scope limitations).

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内执行载体（钩子管理器、CI 工作流、开发容器、构建脚本等），除构建脚本外无其他可执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked in-tree execution carriers (hook managers, CI workflows, dev containers, build scripts, etc.); apart from the build script, there are no other executable carriers.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端构建产物经核读与源码逐行一致：仅做 DOM 属性写入，无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或特权接口调用。
checked_items.en: The browser-side build artifacts were read line-by-line and are consistent with the source code: they only perform DOM attribute writes, with no keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or privileged interface calls.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件逐行核读，全部为插件行插入（insert），未发现任何可执行脚本标记，不存在补丁挂载即执行代码的路径。
evidence.en: The patch file was reviewed line-by-line; all entries are plugin-line inserts (insert). No executable script markers were found, and there is no path for the patch to execute code upon mounting.

evidence.zh: 源码与构建产物中均未出现动态包工具调用，插件没有让模型执行宿主代码的能力。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tool invocation appears in either the source code or the build artifacts. The plugin has no capability to make the model execute host code.

evidence.zh: 存在安装钩子（prepare），内容仅为运行构建工具打包自身源码，属常规构建流程；树内无其他执行载体，未发现安装期下载或执行外部内容的路径。
evidence.en: An install hook (prepare) exists, but its content is only running the build tool to package the plugin's own source code, which is a conventional build process; there are no other execution carriers in the tree, and no path for downloading or executing external content during installation was found.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端模块，构建产物已核读：仅做 DOM 属性打标，无键盘监听、剪贴板访问或凭据类接口调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side module, and the build artifacts have been reviewed: they only perform DOM attribute tagging, with no keyboard listening, clipboard access, or credential-related interface calls.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部代码中的网络请求面（HTTP 请求、WebSocket、命令行外发等），未检出任何网络外联代码。
checked_items.en: Scanned the network request surfaces in all code (HTTP requests, WebSocket, command-line outbound calls, etc.); no outbound network code was detected.

checked_items.zh: 整理了代码中出现的域名，仅文档中的仓库与问题链接（GitHub），插件运行时无任何外发域名。
checked_items.en: Enumerated domains appearing in the code; only GitHub repository and issue links in the documentation. The plugin has no outbound domains at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否存在编码变换后外发、隧道等隐蔽外泄通道，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for covert exfiltration channels such as encoded-transform exfiltration or tunneling — none detected.

evidence.zh: 插件代码无任何网络请求能力，也没有读取凭据的路径，凭据外泄既无读取端也无发送端。
evidence.en: The plugin code has no network request capability and no path for reading credentials. Credential exfiltration has neither a reading end nor a sending end.

checked_items.zh: 核对了依赖清单：内部子插件均为工作区引用（本地包），两个外部 npm 包均锁定精确版本，无未锁定版本的浮动引用。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: internal sub-plugins are all workspace references (local packages), and both external npm packages are pinned to exact versions. No floating references to unpinned versions exist.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖名是否有仿冒官方或知名插件的迹象，未发现；外部包在说明文档中有明确交代。
checked_items.en: Checked whether dependency names show signs of impersonating official or well-known plugins — none found; the external packages are clearly disclosed in the documentation.

checked_items.zh: 核读了补丁文件是否触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行：补丁只做插件行插入，未禁用任何安全组件，未改写安全配置。
checked_items.en: Reviewed whether the patch file touches security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permission settings: the patch only inserts plugin lines, does not disable any security components, and does not modify security configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否监听安全事件并截断审批链，未检出任何事件监听代码。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin listens to security events and truncates the approval chain; no event listener code was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否改写依赖注入或拦截配置，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin modifies dependency injection or intercepts configuration — none detected.

checked_items.zh: 本包会随安装激活一批子插件（含 SSH、远程界面等高能力插件），这是聚合包声明的设计用途，文档已明示；子插件自身代码不在本快照内，未在本报告审计。
checked_items.en: This package activates a batch of sub-plugins upon installation (including high-capability plugins such as SSH and remote interface). This is the declared design purpose of the aggregate package and is clearly stated in the documentation; the sub-plugins' own code is not within this snapshot and was not audited in this report.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件只插入插件行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也没有禁用配置或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch file only inserts plugin lines and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permission settings, nor does it contain configurations that disable settings or downgrade privileges via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何事件监听代码，不存在截断审批链的监听面。
evidence.en: The plugin has no event listener code at all; there is no listener surface that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无历史版本可对比，无法判定升级自动激活；补丁声明的插件行均在本快照内，无版本突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no historical version for comparison, so automatic activation on upgrade cannot be determined; the plugin lines declared in the patch are all within this snapshot, with no version jumps.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写依赖注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加缺失服务使其挂起的路径。
evidence.en: The patch does not modify dependency injection or interception configuration; there is no path for adding missing services to security plugins to cause them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口，未检出；插件没有运行时服务面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port — none detected; the plugin has no runtime service surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否有运行时自我修改、改写宿主行为等动态风险，未检出（宿主半区为空实现，浏览器半区仅做 DOM 打标）。
checked_items.en: Checked for dynamic risks such as runtime self-modification or rewriting host behavior — none detected (the host half is an empty implementation; the browser half only performs DOM tagging).

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（未提供动态验证产物），运行时行为仅基于静态核读。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic verification artifact provided); runtime behavior is based solely on static review.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，与本插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on any port; unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem and is unrelated to this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件元数据与 dsh 声明核对通过：dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明与包内容一致，未发现名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: The plugin metadata and dsh declarations were cross-checked: the dsh.bundle/dsh.client declarations are consistent with the package contents, and no name impersonation or identity anomalies were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：未检出凭据、危险执行、注入、外联等模式；2 条机械命中经人工核读均为良性（构建产物与构建脚本）。
summary.en: Static scan completed: no credentials, dangerous execution, injection, or outbound connection patterns were detected; the 2 mechanical hits were manually reviewed and both are benign (build artifact and build script).

summary.zh: 行为面分析完成：无安装期外联、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取；prepare 钩子仅运行构建工具。
summary.en: Behavior surface analysis completed: no installation-time outbound connections, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reads; the prepare hook only runs the build tool.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：插件未注册任何工具或系统提示片段，无投毒面。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: the plugin registers no tools or system prompt fragments, leaving no poisoning surface.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（未提供 l4-sandbox.json）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage (no l4-sandbox.json provided).

limits.zh: 首次审计（full），无基线版本可比较，未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用）。审计根为平台裁剪后的 packages/dsh-web-ui-all 子目录，证据路径均相对该子目录；本包依赖的子插件（workspace:*）与两个外部 npm 包（@mlgbnb/dsh-archive-manager、dsh-better-sidebar）不在本快照内，其自身代码未在本报告中审计。静态预扫命中 2 条机械规则已逐条裁决：DSH-X08（DG-R3-60，lib/client.js.map 超长行信号）经核读为构建产物 source map，内容为标准映射表与可读源码，非混淆代码，排除；DSH-X02（DG-R3-54，package.json 中 prepare 钩子）内容为运行构建工具 tsdown 打包自身源码，属常规构建脚本，排除。两条均不构成发现项。
limits.en: First audit (full), with no baseline version for comparison; dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (L4 not enabled). The audit root is the platform-trimmed packages/dsh-web-ui-all subdirectory, and all evidence paths are relative to that subdirectory. The sub-plugins this package depends on (workspace:*) and two external npm packages (@mlgbnb/dsh-archive-manager, dsh-better-sidebar) are not in this snapshot; their own code was not audited in this report. The static pre-scan flagged 2 mechanical rules, each adjudicated: DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60, overlong line signal in lib/client.js.map) was reviewed and confirmed to be a standard build artifact source map, whose content is a standard mapping table and readable source code, not obfuscated code — dismissed; DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54, prepare hook in package.json) contains only a tsdown build tool invocation to package its own source code, a conventional build script — dismissed. Both do not constitute findings.
